title: End of tape four and start of tape five
summary: Smith closes tape four and opens tape five, continuing with Mr. Taylor's outline.

blocks.x: It didn't really all originate in one little city called New Orleans. I think it popped up in New York and Kansas City and Chicago pretty much at the same time. But anyway, we're at the end of Side Two of TAPE Four of the interview of the great Samuel Baby Lovett, being interviewed by Art Smith and Charles Crook Goodwin and we will now, I think, end this tape and go on to Tape Five. We'll be right back, ladies and gentlemen.

At the Afterhours, May 8th, this is Side One of Tape Five of the interview with the great Kansas City jazz drummer, Mr. Samuel Baby Lovett, by Art Smith, with the very, very great and fine assistance of Crook Goodwin, and we're staying now -- we're continuing on with the excellent outline and questions prepared by Mr. J.R. TAYLOR, Mr. James Taylor.
